title: Academy - Basuka Energy
metaDescription: Ba-Suka Academy trains women as certified Yennenga Warriors — the talent engine powering Burkina Faso's smart electricity network. Solar PV, battery systems, and professional operations training.

sections.heading: Training the Leaders of the Clean-Energy Revolution
sections.body: The Ba-Suka Academy serves as the talent engine for our operations, creating a specialized pipeline of capable women managers. We invest in comprehensive training, certification, and ongoing support to ensure every graduate is confident, skilled, and positioned for professional career growth.

sections.heading: Your path from graduate to regional lead
sections.body: Certification is a gateway, not an endpoint. Ba-Suka is committed to retaining and advancing every Yennenga Warrior who joins us.

sections.heading: The 8-Week Certification Program
sections.intro: Six weeks of classroom instruction followed by two weeks of supervised practice at an active Swap & Glow™ station. No prior electrical experience required.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.body: At the Ba-Suka Academy, we believe the clean-energy transition is only as strong as the leaders who operate it.

items.q: Who can apply to the Academy?
items.a: Any motivated woman based in Burkina Faso who is interested in technology, sustainability, and community service. No prior experience in electrical engineering is required – we train from the ground up.

items.q: Is there a cost to Participate ?
items.a: Training costs are currently covered by Ba-Suka Energy. Further details on stipend and living support will be confirmed at the application stage.

Our goal is to assign every certified graduate to a station. Placement depends on station availability in your region, but all graduates enter our priority talent pool for new launches and supervisory roles.
Send your name, location, and a short motivation statement to academy@basukaenergy.com. We aim to respond within 7 business days.

sections.heading: Ready to Lead the Clean-energy revolution
body: Applications are open for the next cohort. Join the women building West Africa’s most trusted energy infrastructure.

items.title: Safe Hubs
items.body: Our graduates are the reason Ba-Suka stations are recognized as safe, reliable “women’s places” for energy and mobility services
